title: Pure Labrynth
summary: Labrynth cards with generic Normal Traps and staples. Labrynth is a Normal Trap deck: Welcome Labrynth and Big Welcome Labrynth summon a Labrynth from the Deck, and every time a Normal Trap removes a monster from the field, the Labrynth monsters draw, destroy or summon again. Arianna searches any Labrynth card, Stovie Torbie and Chandraglier Set a Labrynth Spell/Trap from the Deck, and Cooclock lets a Trap Set this turn go off at once. Lady Labrynth Sets a different Normal Trap from the Deck each time one is activated, so the generic Traps are single copies. Arias the Labrynth Butler, the newest card, summons a Labrynth or Sets a live Normal Trap on either Main Phase. Welcome Labrynth locks you into Fiends, so the Extra Deck leans on Fiend Links and Fusions.
main: Arianna the Labrynth Servant
Starter: searches any Labrynth card; draws when a Normal Trap removes a monster.
Ariane the Labrynth Servant
Sends a Normal Trap to summon a Fiend from the Deck; draws when a Trap removes a monster.
Arias the Labrynth Butler
Newest: summons a Labrynth or Sets a live Normal Trap from the hand on either Main Phase.
Labrynth Stovie Torbie
Quick Effect: Sets a Labrynth Spell/Trap from the Deck; revives after a Trap removes a monster.
Labrynth Cooclock
Discards to let a Trap Set this turn be activated.
Labrynth Chandraglier
Quick Effect: Sets a Labrynth Spell/Trap from the Deck; returns to the hand.
Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle
Summons itself from the hand; Sets a different Normal Trap from the Deck on each Trap.
Lovely Labrynth of the Silver Castle
Resets a Normal Trap from the GY; destroys a card in their hand or field.
Labrynth Archfiend
Summons itself on a Trap; Sets an attack-declaration Trap from the Deck.
Labrynth Labyrinth
Field Spell: Welcome Labrynth also destroys a card; generic Traps summon a Fiend.
Labrynth Set-Up
Recycles two Labrynth Spells/Traps to Set generic Normal Traps from the Deck.
Welcome Labrynth
Summons a Labrynth from the Deck; Sets itself again from the GY.
Big Welcome Labrynth
Summons a Labrynth from the hand, Deck or GY and bounces one of yours; bounces their card from the GY.
Farewelcome Labrynth
Negates an attack and destroys a card; Sets a generic Normal Trap.
Trap Trick
Generic: Sets a second copy of a Normal Trap from the Deck, live this turn.
Destructive Daruma Karma Cannon
Generic Normal Trap: flips every monster face-down.
Compulsory Evacuation Device
Generic Normal Trap: bounces a monster, which triggers the Labrynths.
Torrential Tribute
Generic Normal Trap: wipes the monsters on a summon.
Transaction Rollback
Generic Normal Trap: copies a Normal Trap in either GY.
